name: Product Builder CoS
tagline: Turns a signed-off product plan into a checklist someone actually tracks
description: Aimed at product managers who have no shortage of ideas and nobody to chase the follow-through. Once a plan is agreed it breaks the work into tracked items, keeps an owner and a date attached to each one, and flags the pieces that have quietly stopped moving.
author: sneharavindra
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
